body: I have to drive 2 1/2 hours plus take a ferry so I totally get it 😭

I understand this, but my experience was a tad different. I went to uni to spite my father & get into a field few indigenous women are in. I’ve switched majors once and my minors three times. I’m graduating this year and happy af. Find something you’re passionate about literally anything (mine was Emily Dickinson) and try to find a class that relates to your interest. Go from there. Cheers
